newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz says hopes for sales boon from bank merger.
newsitem.headline: Allianz says hopes for sales boon from bank merger.

text.p: Allianz AG said on Monday it hoped the merger between Bavarian banks Bayerische Vereinsbank AG and Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechsel Bank AG would translate into improved sales of its insurance products.
The insurer will own 15 percent of the merged bank, for which plans were announced earlier on Monday.
"The main strategic implication for us comes in terms of distribution of insurance products. The chances for this will be raised by this large bank," said an Allianz spokesman.
Allianz already has a distribution agreement with Hypo-Bank, of which it owns 22.1 percent, and four percent of Vereinsbank.
In a separate statement, Allianz chairman Henning Schulte-Noelle said the merger gave Allianz an opportunity of creating shareholder value.
"The enhanced strategic positioning of the new bank creates a significantly improved investment for Allianz, on behalf of both policy holders and shareholders," he said.
